title: Atlas Immo
featuredTitle: Atlas Immo: from a dated template to the agency people call first
teaser: A full redesign and rebuild with a listings admin, WhatsApp enquiries and local SEO.

case.heroLead: A Tangier real estate agency stuck behind a dated template. We rebuilt how it looks, loads and takes enquiries.

problem.title: A good agency hidden behind a bad website
problem.lead: Buyers judged the agency in seconds, and the site gave them reasons to leave.
pains: Slow on phones, 7.8 seconds to show listings
No WhatsApp button, no clear next step
Listings updated by editing code, so rarely updated

journey.title: Discover
journey.text: We learned the agency, its buyers and its competitors in the city.

journey.title: Free design
journey.text: A custom homepage in Figma. The owner approved it before paying.

journey.title: Build
journey.text: Clean code, a listings admin and WhatsApp enquiries, with free changes.

journey.title: Launch and grow
journey.text: Live, tracked and checked after 14 days. Then monthly improvements.

built.title: Listings people can filter
built.text: Search by area, size and price, built for a thumb on a phone.

built.title: An admin the team uses
built.text: Add, edit and unpublish listings in minutes, no developer needed.

built.title: Enquiries in one tap
built.text: Every listing opens a WhatsApp chat with the property already named.

results.label: To publish a listing
results.note: Was a week, through a developer

quote.text: Clients now message us from the listing itself. We stopped losing leads to a slow site.

title: Nour Boutique
teaser: An online clothing shop with a clean checkout and a catalogue the owner updates alone.

case.heroAccent: a shop that sells while it sleeps.
case.heroLead: A clothing boutique that lived on Instagram messages. We gave it a store where customers can browse, pick a size and pay.

problem.title: Every sale started with a long chat
problem.lead: Customers asked for sizes and prices in messages, and many gave up before ordering.
pains: Prices and stock lived in the owner’s phone
Orders were written on paper and often lost
No way to sell when the shop was closed

journey.title: Discover
journey.text: We mapped the catalogue, the sizes and how customers like to pay.

journey.title: Free design
journey.text: A bright, product-first homepage and product page in Figma.

journey.title: Build
journey.text: Catalogue, cart, checkout and an order list the owner can run alone.

journey.title: Launch and grow
journey.text: Live with a first collection loaded and photos made fast for phones.

built.title: A catalogue that looks like the brand
built.text: Big photos, clear sizes and stock, loading fast on mobile data.

built.title: Checkout in three taps
built.text: Cart, delivery details and payment with nothing extra to learn.

built.title: Orders under control
built.text: Every order lands in one list, ready to prepare and track.

results.label: Selling hours
results.note: Even when the shop is closed

quote.text: I upload a new piece in minutes and it is on sale the same day.

title: Clinique Tanger
teaser: A booking and patient-queue app that replaced the paper diary at reception.

case.heroLead: A busy clinic running on a paper diary and a ringing phone. We built a booking and queue tool the whole team uses.

problem.title: The reception desk was the bottleneck
problem.lead: Every booking meant a call, and double bookings were common.
pains: Appointments written in a paper diary
No view of who is waiting right now

journey.title: Discover
journey.text: We sat at reception and followed a full day of bookings.

journey.title: Free design
journey.text: A calm, high-contrast interface designed for a busy desk.

journey.title: Build
journey.text: Booking, patient queue, reminders and roles with secure login.

journey.title: Launch and grow
journey.text: Rolled out room by room, with training and support on day one.

built.title: A day view the desk lives in
built.text: Every appointment and who is waiting, on one screen.

built.title: Reminders by message
built.text: Patients are reminded automatically, so fewer no-shows.

built.title: Roles and secure access
built.text: Reception, doctors and the manager each see what they need.

quote.text: Reception finally has time to look after the people in front of them.

title: Café Médina
teaser: A menu site and monthly care: hosting, updates and seasonal changes handled for them.

case.heroLead: A café with a lovely menu and no time for websites. We built the site, then took over the technical side for good.

problem.title: A website nobody had time to look after
problem.lead: The old site showed last summer’s menu and broke after every update.
pains: Menu and prices months out of date
No one to call when it broke

journey.title: Discover
journey.text: We learned the menu rhythm: seasons, specials and opening hours.

journey.title: Free design
journey.text: A warm, appetising homepage and menu page in Figma.

journey.title: Build
journey.text: A fast menu site with WhatsApp bookings and Google Maps.

journey.title: Managed care
journey.text: We handle hosting, updates and a monthly improvement.

built.title: A menu that is always current
built.text: Seasonal changes are done by us, usually within a day.

built.title: Bookings on WhatsApp
built.text: One tap to reserve a table, with the date already filled in.

built.title: A monthly report in plain words
built.text: What changed, how it performed, and what comes next.

quote.text: We send a message, and the site is updated. That is all we wanted.
